text:
Roope Hintz played only 53 games last season, and the healthy version is a reminder of what Dallas missed. He has 17 points in 18 games (8 goals, 9 assists) on 16:28 a night, and his goals have swung results, 34th of 522 skaters in our wins added.

The finishing is the soft spot. He is shooting 22.9%, with 8 goals on 6.1 expected, and our range for his shooting sits nearer 14%. Dallas has also scored 3.8 more goals than its chances deserve with him on the ice. Expect some of that to come back to the pack.

What should not fade is the defense. Evolving-Hockey ranked him 20th among forwards in wins above replacement last season and put him in the 99th percentile for taking chances away, after accounting for teammates and competition. That is rare for a forward who also scores.

Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking found 55% of his shots came off the rush, and he carried the puck in on 63% of his entries. Watch him in transition. Our projection has him finishing between 55 and 80 points, with his ice time down a little over the last ten games.
